title: T-78: a business started in a merged partner's building reaches the owner and is never wiped. (a) the host's start in the client's empty building ROUTES and the client runs the game's own start; it survives past the old 10-minute window. (b) REFUSAL + HEAL, after the old window: with the owner's heal held (healhold lever) the host refuses the owner's empty record and keeps the business; released, the owner heals from it. (c) SHUTDOWN: the owner's own shutdown empties the host's copy (ShutDown=true accepted). (d) STAND-IN (D69): with the client away the host starts a business natively in the client's building; it goes home on return. DECLARED LONG WAIT: step 22 sleeps 660 s. NO save.
preconditions: Fixture save1 (host melaus, client Client1). Dev build with T-78 (startbiz / shutbiz / healhold levers; rent / forrent / setbiz / regstate / merge / paperwork levers are BAMP_DEV). At least three retail units for rent on the client's machine. Uses the driver's drop/relaunch steps. FIXTURE HYGIENE: NOTHING is saved.
oracles_absent: heal of my empty .* NOT applied

the client's rents reach the host's ledger
premise: rented, no business
